title: Retire the legacy analysis decision compatibility layer
description:
Analysis helpers still depend on a downgraded decision shape even when the export already has canonical validated decisions. `scripts/analysis/extract_decisions.py` now deep-converts canonical decisions back to plain JSON trees to keep legacy consumers working, and `scripts/analysis/blunder_eval_common.py` still carries camelCase/snake_case compatibility helpers because the analysis stack is split across old and new decision formats.

Follow up by moving the analysis pipeline onto one canonical decision representation and pushing JSON serialization to true I/O boundaries only. The target state is that internal analysis code does not need to shallow-copy or down-convert canonical decisions just to satisfy older formatters, and the mixed snake_case/camelCase compatibility helpers can be deleted or sharply reduced.
